name: Sophie
source:
Sophie specializes in Psychokinesis. she's known as a prodigy, being able to control not just objects, but pure energy. She enjoys painting and writing fiction, to test the limits of how her magic can alter the fabric of physical reality.

It's rumored that she has been scouted for the Academy years prior, but delayed her start date to be the same as Alice's.
